_comment: connections-derived-dependencies (REQ-DCN-001). The suggestion ids an organisation dismissed for a usage, so the Suggested connections panel does not offer them again. Written by ConnectionSuggestionService::dismiss() after the per-usage guard; hidden on the form. Suggestions themselves are computed on each request and never stored.

dismissedConnectionSuggestions.title: Dismissed connection suggestions
dismissedConnectionSuggestions.description: Connections this organisation chose not to add to this usage. They are no longer suggested.
